#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page (title + current date) to report.pdf."""
import datetime
import os
import sys

from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

INPUT = "report.pdf"
COVER = "cover_page.pdf"
OUTPUT = "report_with_cover.pdf"


def main():
    if not os.path.exists(INPUT):
        sys.exit(f"error: {INPUT} not found in the workspace")

    today = datetime.date.today()
    date_str = today.strftime("%B %d, %Y")

    # --- Create the cover page ---
    c = canvas.Canvas(COVER, pagesize=letter)
    width, height = letter

    # Title
    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 28)
    c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height / 2 + 40, "Annual Financial Report")

    # Horizontal rule under the title
    c.setStrokeColorRGB(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
    c.setLineWidth(1.5)
    c.line(width / 2 - 180, height / 2 + 15, width / 2 + 180, height / 2 + 15)

    # Current date
    c.setFont("Helvetica", 16)
    c.setFillColorRGB(0.35, 0.35, 0.35)
    c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height / 2 - 15, date_str)

    c.save()
    print(f"Created cover page: {COVER} (date: {date_str})")

    # --- Merge: cover page + original report ---
    cover_reader = PdfReader(COVER)
    report_reader = PdfReader(INPUT)

    writer = PdfWriter()
    for page in cover_reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)
    for page in report_reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)

    with open(OUTPUT, "wb") as f:
        writer.write(f)

    # --- Validate ---
    check = PdfReader(OUTPUT)
    first_page_text = check.pages[0].extract_text() or ""
    expected_title = "Annual Financial Report"
    print(f"Merged output written: {OUTPUT}")
    print(f"Original report pages: {len(report_reader.pages)}")
    print(f"Total pages in output: {len(check.pages)}")
    print(f"Cover page contains title: {expected_title in first_page_text}")
    print(f"Cover page contains date: {date_str in first_page_text}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import importlib

mods = [

    "PyPDF2",

]

for name in mods:

        mod = importlib.import_module(name)
        ver = getattr(mod, "__version__", "unknown")
        print(f"{name}: available ({ver})")
    except Exception as exc:
        print(f"{name}: NOT available ({type(exc).__name__})")

"""Dump the tail of report.pdf to inspect its xref format."""
data = open("report.pdf", "rb").read()
print("size:", len(data))
print("----- last 500 bytes -----")
chunk = data[-500:]
for i in range(0, len(chunk), 16):
    line = chunk[i:i + 16]
    hexs = " ".join(f"{b:02x}" for b in line)
    asc = "".join(chr(b) if 32 <= b <= 126 else "." for b in line)
    print(f"{len(data)-500+i:6d}  {hexs:<47}  {asc}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Debug parsing of the trailer region of report.pdf."""
from pdf_utils import (parse_dict, parse_hex_string, parse_array, parse_name,
                       parse_object, skip_ws, PdfParseError)

data = open("report.pdf", "rb").read()

# trailer starts at 1951 ("trailer\n<<")
for label, off in [
    ("dict at 1959", 1959),
    ("array at 1968", 1968),
    ("hex1 at 1969", 1969),
    ("hex2 at 2003", 2003),
]:
    try:
        if label.startswith("hex"):
            val, pos = parse_hex_string(data, off)
            print(f"{label}: OK -> {val!r} ends at {pos}")
        elif label.startswith("array"):
            val, pos = parse_array(data, off)
            print(f"{label}: OK -> {val!r} ends at {pos}")
        else:
            val, pos = parse_dict(data, off)
            print(f"{label}: OK -> {val!r} ends at {pos}")
    except PdfParseError as exc:
        print(f"{label}: FAILED -> {exc}")
        # show next 40 bytes from failure context if parse_object failed
        pos = skip_ws(data, off)
        print("   context:", data[pos:pos + 40])
